title: In vivo evaluation of novel synthetic pyrazolones as CDK9 inhibitors with enhanced pharmacokinetic properties.
authors: Husseiny, Ebtehal M; Abulkhair, Hamada S; El-Sebaey, Samiha A; Sayed, Manal M; Anwer, Kurls E
one_liner_zh: 该文研究CDK9抑制剂合成与体内药代动力学，与蛋白质-DNA互作及TF-DNA结合建模完全无关。
abstract: Aim: The structural optimization of our recently reported CDK9 inhibitor to furnish novel aminopyrazolones and methylpyrazolones with improved pharmacokinetics.Materials & methods: The synthesis of the targeted compounds was accomplished via conventional, grinding and microwave-assisted processes. The cytotoxicity of them was assayed against three carcinomas.Results: Analogs 2, 4 and 6 showed significant cytotoxicity and selectivity toward all tested cells. They also displayed potent CDK9 inhibition. Compound 6 arrested MCF-7 cycle at G2/M phase by stimulating the apoptotic pathway. The in vivo biodistribution of radiolabeled compound 6 displayed a potent targeting capability of (131)I in solid tumors.Conclusion: Entity 6 is a potent CDK9 inhibitor where (131)I-compound 6 can be used as a significant radiopharmaceutical imaging tool for tumors.
abstract_zh: 目的：对我们近期报道的CDK9抑制剂进行结构优化，以制备具有改善药代动力学特性的新型氨基吡唑啉酮和甲基吡唑啉酮。材料与方法：通过常规法、研磨法和微波辅助法完成了目标化合物的合成。针对三种癌细胞系评估了其细胞毒性。结果：类似物2、4和6对所有测试细胞均表现出显著的细胞毒性和选择性，并显示出强效的CDK9抑制活性。化合物6通过刺激凋亡途径使MCF-7细胞周期阻滞于G2/M期。放射性标记化合物6的体内生物分布显示其对实体瘤中的(131)I具有强效靶向能力。结论：实体6是一种强效CDK9抑制剂，其中(131)I-化合物6可作为肿瘤显像的重要放射性药物工具。
